faq.q: Do you cost less for AI development too?
faq.a: We don’t claim a gap there. On Clutch, Philippine and Australian agencies charge in the same band for AI development. What you get from us is reviewed work, a fixed quote and published starting prices.
AI takes over the repetitive hours, and a person still reviews every piece of work before it reaches you.

You see progress every week, a person reviews every piece of work, and your data stays in your systems wherever possible. The Philippines also has a national privacy law, enforced by an independent National Privacy Commission.

notes: Hero tagline from Brand DNA section 7, approved for Australian ads for web, design and SEO work; before launch, confirm the real A$ prices support it. The Clutch table states plainly that there is no gap with Australia for AI development (Brand DNA, Rules for price claims), and the FAQ repeats it. Every promise on the page is Brand DNA wording: the five price promises are verbatim from 'Our honest pricing promise' (confirm each is true before launch), the price card line is the Brand DNA's embedded-developers line, and the FAQ answers are the Brand DNA's 'Questions buyers will ask'. Header marks no nav item. One Primary in the hero and one in the closing band. Every number carries a Source key and a dated source line in its own section.
